title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series Vol. 1: Sarah Bryant
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．１ 「サラ・ブライアント」
overview:
Character CG from Virtua Fighter and an image song blend together beautifully...

Volume 1 of the CG Portrait Series is devoted to Sarah Bryant. Newly made computer graphics show her away from the ring - at the beach, lounging in the sun and practicing her moves - in a sequence staged to her image song "Dancing Shadow", a single from the Virtua Fighter 2 vocal album Dancing Shadows.

Choose "Karaoke" and the lyrics appear on screen so you can sing along.

- Original CG portraits of Sarah Bryant
- Image song with a karaoke mode

「バーチャファイター」のキャラクターCGとイメージソングが華麗に融合する…
